text.p: Perceptron Inc said Monday it has acquired Autospect Inc of Ann Arbor, Michigan by issuing 387,000 shares of Perceptron stock.
It said the transaction was valued at $12 million on the date the purchase agreement was reached.

It said plans call for the 1997 sales of Autospect products to represent about 10 percent of the companies' consolidated revenues and for the earnings to be slightly accretive to the companies' earnings per share.

Autospect has developed products that measure quality features such as gloss and distinction of reflected image. It also has products which detect dirt and other defects embedded within painted surfaces.
Perceptron designs, manufactures and markets information-based process measurement and guidance solutions for industry.
